terra.problem: The line says Persia ‘ruled the world.’ It was a vast empire, but it did not rule the whole world.

The moments do not establish that these events happened in Persia proper. The temple work happened in Jerusalem, and Ezra traveled from Babylon to Jerusalem; these places were under Persian rule but were not in the Persian homeland. Ezra 1 does not say where Cyrus issued his proclamation, and Daniel’s vision was by the Tigris. The card should distinguish Persia proper from the wider empire.
Several words may be difficult at a 5th-grade level, including ‘proclamation,’ ‘standstill,’ ‘prospered,’ ‘prophesying,’ and ‘decrees.’
